title: Wire broadened search and filter state into RecipesListView
description: Update the recipes list to use the expanded free-text predicate, combine it with active filters, persist filter state per scene, present the filter sheet from the toolbar, and show the filtered empty state with a clear-filters affordance.
acceptance_criteria: Free-text matching checks `displayName`, `metadata.title`, normalized tags, and ingredient names with case-insensitive substring semantics.
`RecipesListView` stores filter state in `@SceneStorage`, shows the filter toolbar button with filled/unfilled symbol variants, and displays the active-filter badge count when nonzero.
The empty state distinguishes filter-driven zero results from query-only zero results and preserves the query when clearing filters.
